rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
C = Q/V
C = ε₀A/d
U = ½CV²

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ treat "AC voltage applied to resistor" as one blob → ✅ split into: ac voltage applied to resistor, inductor, capacitor.  ·  ❌ state the rule without its limit → ✅ note when it applies / stops applying.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Capacitance C = Q/V; parallel-plate C = ε₀A/d (larger with dielectric: C = ε₀εᵣA/d).  ·  Energy stored U = ½CV² = Q²/2C.
